title: First seeing Duke Ellington in Harlem ballrooms
summary: He recalls seeing Ellington at the Savoy or Rockland Palace, and Eddie Cole with Noble Sissle's band, always standing near the bass player.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Where was the first time you saw Duke in person? Where and when? Do you remember?
The first time I saw Duke in person was... wow, let's see...
You mentioned that Wellman Braud was playing bass when you first saw him.

Yeah, I'm thinking it must have been at the Savoy Ballroom, or some ballroom in Harlem or in New York. Because there used to be a lot of dances. That's the first place I saw Noble Sissle's band; I think it was the Rockland Palace. Well, it could have been the Rockland Palace that I first saw Duke. And that's where I first saw Nat Cole's brother, even though I didn't know Nat at the time. Eddie
Cole was playing bass with the Noble Sissle band. (We do jump around, don't we...)

But these things come back when certain things trigger other things. Yeah, I think that was the first time I saw Duke, was either at Rockland Palace or the Savoy. I used to stand down... And naturally, I'd stand wherever the bass player was; that's where I'd be.
